Amharic: ስለዚህ ተደራሽነቱ ይሻሻል ዘንድ በዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎች ሰዎች እነዚህን አስፈላጊ አገልግሎቶች ለማግኘት ምን ያህል ጊዜ እንደሚፈጅባቸው ትክክለኛ ግምቶችን ለማድረግ ፈልገው ነበር፡፡

Source: They mapped out the Ifanadiana area in Madagascar by focusing on the natural features of the land.
Luganda: Baalamba ekitundu kya Infanadian ekisangibwa mu Madagascar nga batunuulira enkalira z’ettaka ez’obutonde.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ya àwòran agbègbè Ifanadiana ní Madagascar nípa fí fojú sí àbùdá àdáni ilẹ̀ náà.
Zulu: Bakhiphe indawo yase-Ifanadiana ese-Madagascar ngokugxila kwezemvelo yalomhlaba.
Hausa: Sun tsara taswirar yankin Ifanadiana a Madagascar ta hanyar mai da hankali kan yanayin yanayin ƙasar.
Northern Sotho: Ba lekodišišitše lefelo la Ifanadiana ka Madagascar ka go nepiša dilo tša tlhago tša naga.
Amharic: በማዳጋስካር የሚገኘውን የኢፋናዲያና አካባቢ በመሬቱ የተፈጥሮ ባህሪያት ላይ በማተኮር ካርታ አዘጋጅተዋል፡፡

Source: They mapped over 100 000 buildings, 23 000 km of footpaths, and 4 925 residential areas.
Luganda: Baalamba ebizimbe ebisoba mu 100 000, 23 000 km ez’amakubo g’ebigere n’ebifo ebisulwamu 4 925.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ya àwòrán àwọn ilé tó ju 100 000, ojú ìrìnsẹ̀ tó tó 23 000 km, àti ìbùgbé tó tó 4 925.
Zulu: Benza imephu yezakhiwo ezingaphezulu kwezi-100 000, amakhilomitha ayizi-23 000 ezindlela zezinyawo, kanye nezindawo zokuhlala eziyi-4 925.
Hausa: Sun tsara gine-gine sama da 100 000, kilomita 23 000 na hanyoyin ƙafa, da wuraren zama 4 925.
Northern Sotho: Ba lekodišišitše meago ya go feta ye 100 000, dikhilometara tše 23 000 tša basepelakaomaoto, le mafelo a madulo a 4 925.
Amharic: ከ100000 በላይ ህንጻዎችን፣ 23000 ኪ.ሜ የእግር መንገዶችን እና 4925 የመኖሪያ አካባቢዎችን ካርታ ሰርተዋል፡፡

Source: They then recorded the time it would take residents to get to healthcare services on foot, and in different types of weather.
Luganda: Oluvannyuma baakwata obudde abatuuze bwe baali beetaaga okutuuka mu bifo we bafuna obujjanjabi nga batambuzizza bigere, era mu mbeera y’obudde ey’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sì ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ àsìkò tí ó má ń gba àwọn olùgbé láti dé ibi ètò ìtọ́jú ìléra lórí ìrìnsẹ̀, àti orísiríṣi ojú ọjọ́.
Zulu: Babe sebebhala phansi isikhathi esingathatha izakhamuzi ukuthi zithole izinsiza zezempilo uma zihamba ngezinyawo, ezimeni ezahlukene zezulu.
Hausa: Sannan sun rubuta lokacin da zai ɗauki mazauna wurin zuwa ayyukan kiwon lafiya da ƙafa, da kuma yanayi daban-daban.
Northern Sotho: Go tloga fao ba ngwadile nako yeo badudi ba tlago e tšea go fihla ditirelong tša tlhokomelo ya maphelo ka maoto, le ka mehuteng ye e fapanego ya tša boso.
Amharic: ከዚያም ነዋሪዎች ወደ ጤና መጠበቂያ አገልግሎቶች ለመድረስ በእግር ጉዞ እና በተለያዩ የአየር ሁኔታዎች የሚፈጅባቸውን ጊዜ መዝግበዋል፡፡

Source: They also calculated the shortest distance to the nearest healthcare service.
Luganda: Baabala n’obuwanvu bw’ekkubo ery’okumpi okutuuka mu kifo ewajjanjabirwa ekiri okumpi.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ṣe ìsirò ọ̀nà tó kéré jù tó súnmọ́n ètò ìtójú ìléra.
Zulu: Baphinde babala ibanga elifushane lokufinyelela kwizinsiza zezempilo.
Hausa: Sun kuma ƙididdige mafi ƙarancin tazara zuwa sabis na kiwon lafiya mafi kusa.
Northern Sotho: Gape ba hlakantše monabo o mokopana kudu go ya go tirelo ya tlhokomelo ya maphelo.
Amharic: እንዲሁም በቅርብ ወደሚገኘው የጤና እንክብካቤ አገልግሎት ለመድረስ በጣም አጭሩን ርቀት አስልተዋል፡፡

Source: They found that more than 75% of the Ifanadiana community lived more than an hour away from healthcare sites.
Luganda: Baazuula nti abantu abasoba mu bitundu 75% ababeera mu kitundu kya Ifanadiana baali beetaaga essaawa esukka ku emu okutuuka mu bifo ewajjanjabirwa.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣàkíyèsí pé ìdá 75% àwọn ènìyàn ní agbègbè Ifanadiana ni wọ́n ń gbé ju wákàtí kan jìnà sí ibi ìtọ́jú ìléra.
Zulu: Bathole ukuthi ngaphezulu kuka-75% womphakathi wase Ifanadiana uhlala kude ngesikhathi esingaphezulu kwehora kwizindawo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa fiye da kashi 75% na al'ummar Ifanadiana sun rayu fiye da sa'a guda daga wuraren kiwon lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše gore tekano ya go feta 75% ya setšhaba sa Ifanadiana e be e dula monabo wa go feta iri e tee go ya mafelong a tlhokomelo ya maphelo.
Amharic: ከ75% በላይ የሚሆነው የኢፋናዲያና ማህበረሰብ ከጤና አጠባበቅ ጣቢያዎቸ ከአንድ ሰአት በላይ ርቆ እንደሚኖር አረጋግጠዋል፡፡

Source: The northern and eastern part of Ifanadiana, in particular, were problematic areas.

Zulu: Ingxenye yasenyakatho nempumalanga ye-Ifanadiana, ikakhulukazi, izona zindawo ebezinezinkinga.
Hausa: Musamman yankin arewa da gabashin Ifanadiana sun kasance yankunan da ke da matsala.
Northern Sotho: Karolo ya ka leboa le ya ka bohlabela bja Ifanadiana, kudukudu, e be e le mafelo ao a bego a na le mathata.
Amharic: በተለይም የኢፋናዲያና ሰሜናዊ እና ምስራቃዊ ክፍሎች እክል የሚበዛባቸው አካባቢዎች ነበሩ፡፡

Source: In some instances, people were more than five hours away from decent health services.
Luganda: Mu mbeera ezimu, abantu baali beetaaga essaawa ezisoba mu ttaano okutuuka mu bifo ewafunibwa obujjanjabi.
Yoruba: Fún àpẹẹrẹ, àwọn èèyàn fi bí i wákàtí márùn-ún jìnà sí ètò ìlera to dára.
Zulu: Kwezinye izimo, abantu bebeqhele ngaphezulu ngamahora amahlanu emitholampilo ehloniphekile.
Hausa: A wasu lokuta, mutane sun fi sa'o'i biyar nesa da ingantattun ayyukan kiwon lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Mabakeng a mangwe, batho ba be ba dula diiri tša go feta tše hlano go ya ditirelong tša tlhokomelo ya maphelo.
Amharic: በአንዳንድ አጋጣሚዎች ሰዎች ጥሩ የጤና አገልግሎት ከሚገኝባቸው ቦታዎች ከአምስት ሰአታት በላይ ርቀው ይገኙ ነበር፡፡

Source: This geographical information is available electronically to the residents and healthcare workers.
Luganda: Obubaka buno weebuli ku mutimbagano eri abatuuze n’abeebyobulamu.
Yoruba: Àwọn ìròyìn nípa agbègbè ọ̀hún ló wà lóri ẹ̀rọ alátagbà fún àwọn tó ń gbé ní agbègbè náà àti àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ elétò ìléra.

Northern Sotho: Tshedimošo ye ya mabapi le mafelo e hwetšagala ka elektroniki ke badudi le ke bašomi ba tlhokomelo ya maphelo.

Source: Researchers unfortunately didn’t survey the amount of people living in the area, which may skew their results.
Luganda: Ebyembi abanoonyereza tebaanoonyereza ku muwendo gw’abantu ababeera mu kitundu, ekiyinza okukyusa bye baazuula.
Yoruba: Ó ṣe ni láàánú pé àwọn Aṣèwádìí ò mọ òdiwọ̀n iye èèyàn tó ń gbé ní agbègbè náà, tí ó sì le mú àyípadà ògigì èsì wọn.

Hausa: Masu binciken da rashin alheri ba su bincika adadin mutanen da ke zaune a yankin ba, wanda zai iya karkatar da sakamakon su.
Northern Sotho: Ka maswabi banyakišiši ga se ba nyakišiša ka ga tekano ya batho bao ba dulago lefelong leo, gomme se se ka phamoša dipoelo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ  በሚያሳዝን ሁኔታ በአካባቢው በሚኖሩ ሰዎች ትክክለኛ ብዛት ላይ ጥናት አላደረጉም ነበር፣ ይህም ውጤታቸውን ሊያዛባው ይችላል፡፡

Source: They also did not consider the use of transport in the travel time.

Northern Sotho: Gape ga se ba hlokomela go šomišwa ga dinamelwa go nako ya go tšea maeto.
Amharic: ለመጓዝ በሚፈጀው ጊዜም የትራንስፖርት አጠቃቀምን ከግምት ውስጥ አላስገቡም፡፡

Source: They say more work is needed in this field, which is called “geographical accessibility modelling”.
Luganda: Bagamba nti waliwo eby’okukola ebirala bingi mu kisaawe kino, ekiyitibwa “geographical accessibility modelling”.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé ọ̀pọ̀ iṣẹ́ nílò ní lójú ọ̀nà yìí, tí wọn ń pè ní ''nìnì ànfààní sí àwọn àwòṣe agbègbè''.
Zulu: Bathi kusadingeka umsebenzi omningi kulo mkhakha, obizwa ngokuthi “indlela yokufinyeleleka ngokwendawo”.
Hausa: Sun ce ana buƙatar ƙarin aiki a wannan fanni, wanda ake kira “samfurin samun damar yin amfani da ƙasa”.
Northern Sotho: Ba bolela gore go hlokega gore go dirwe mošomo o montši ka mo lefapheng le, leo le bitšwago “mokgwa wa phihlelelo ya mafelo”.

Source: In other words, more studies should use computer modelling and geographical data to map access to health services.

Source: The study was done in Madagascar, and the authors were from Madagascar and France.
